Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the overlap. Sources showed The Family Man was written by David Diamond and David Weissman, and Evolution was written by David Diamond, David Weissman, and Don Jakoby. The overlapping screenwriter who co-wrote the Nicolas Cage/Téa Leoni film is David Weissman (also David Diamond), not Don Jakoby, who did not work on The Family Man.
